verdict.rationale: Live probes confirm that PayPal publishes an llms.txt index at developer.paypal.com/llms.txt and serves agent-friendly markdown versions of its agentic-commerce docs (e.g. /agent-ready/overview.md, plus docs.paypal.ai .md API reference pages). An agent can be pointed directly at these. missing for 10: first-party documentation describing the llms.txt and markdown docs offering, and confirmation that llms.txt fully indexes the agentic-commerce, Store Sync and cart API sections.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs

citations.quote: PROBE llms.txt: HTTP 200 at https://developer.paypal.com/llms.txt # PayPal Developer Documentation
PROBE docs-md: HTTP 200 at https://developer.paypal.com/agent-ready/overview.md # Agent Ready overview (/agent-ready/overview)
